# Spinneys

> > Spinneys is a premium grocery retailer operating across the UAE and GCC region, offering high-quality food products and community-focused retail experiences.

Spinneys is a leading supermarket chain with operations in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and expanding presence across the GCC including Oman and Saudi Arabia. The company partners with international brands like Waitrose and operates community initiatives such as the Spinneys Cycle Challenge and Spinneys Family Run.

## Key Topics

- Premium grocery retail
- UAE market operations
- GCC expansion (Saudi Arabia, Oman)
- Dubai and Riyadh locations
- Waitrose partnership
- Al Fair grocery brand
- Public offering and investor relations
- Ali Saeed Juma Al Bwardy (leadership)
- Spinneys Cycle Challenge
- Spinneys Family Run
- Community engagement programs
- High-quality food products
- Regional retail expansion
